verdict.rationale: Asana provides a well-documented RESTful public API (with resource-oriented URLs, JSON, in-context explorer), official OpenAPI spec repo, official client libraries, webhooks, sandbox environment, and a formal deprecation/versioning process — all clearly aimed at enabling programmatic/agentic driving of the product. Independent probe confirms llms.txt and OpenAPI spec repo exist, corroborating the docs claims. Missing for 10: a live discoverable openapi.json endpoint (probe found 404s) and independent third-party developer commentary validating API robustness beyond official docs.
